tokens.name: ui-bg
tokens.usage: Tool chrome: page background behind the two columns.

tokens.name: ui-panel
tokens.usage: Tool chrome: panel surface (.panel), active template tile.

tokens.name: ui-input
tokens.usage: Tool chrome: text inputs, selects, textareas and inactive template tiles, inset into ui-panel.

tokens.name: ui-border
tokens.usage: Tool chrome: 1px field borders, section rules, scrollbar thumbs, and the fill of ghost buttons and nav buttons. Source pair below 3:1 on ui-panel (1.36 dark, 1.46 light): borders are decorative, the field fill carries the shape.

tokens.name: ui-text
tokens.usage: Tool chrome: primary text on ui-bg, ui-panel, ui-input and ui-border (≥10:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: ui-muted
tokens.usage: Tool chrome: labels, hints, inactive tile labels on ui-panel and ui-bg (7.6:1 dark, 6.0:1 light).

tokens.name: ui-accent
tokens.usage: Tool chrome: primary button fill, section headings (h2), active tile border, optgroup labels. As text on ui-panel: 7.8:1 dark, 4.2:1 light (headings are 14px bold uppercase; the light pair is a source value under 4.5:1).

tokens.name: ui-accent-text
tokens.usage: Tool chrome: label on a ui-accent button (8.1:1 dark; 4.26:1 light, a source pair just under 4.5:1 at 15px bold).

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Slide background. GENERATED per post by generatePalette(): base hue, saturation 22–36, lightness 93–97 (dark mood: 18 / 12). Value shown is the reference generation at hue 28.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Slide text on bg, a2, a3 (≥8.5:1 in the reference generations). Generated: base hue, sat 28–42, light 14–22 (dark mood: 12 / 94).

tokens.name: a0
tokens.usage: Slide primary accent: eyebrows, numbers, plates, timeline dots, card left border. Generated: base hue, sat 55–70, light 42–52. Text in a0 on bg is 3.3:1 in the light reference, so keep it to 22px+ bold labels.

tokens.name: a1
tokens.usage: Slide secondary accent, alternated with a0 per item (--acc). Generated from the scheme's second hue at accent light +3. Only 1.5:1 against bg in the light reference: use it as a fill or a mark, never as small text.

tokens.name: a2
tokens.usage: Slide tint: odd ledger rows, ladder gradient start, third cover dot. Generated: sat 30, light 88 (dark mood: 26 / 24). Carries ink text.

tokens.name: a3
tokens.usage: Slide tint: even ledger rows and soft secondary fills. Generated: sat 30, light 82 (dark mood: 24 / 20). Carries ink text.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Slide card stock: fixed in the source for card, grid tile, ladder and badge surfaces, in every mood. Text on it is ink; in the dark mood ink is near-white and fails on paper (1.1:1), a known source issue.

tokens.name: drag-outline
tokens.usage: Editor only: dashed 3px outline of a movable block (.movable). Never exported.

tokens.name: drag-active
tokens.usage: Editor only: the movable outline while it is being dragged.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Cover label above the title, uppercase, in a0.

styles.name: tag
styles.usage: Top-of-slide tag on content slides, uppercase at 50–55% opacity.

styles.name: phrase
styles.usage: The English phrase (.en) on card-type slides; 24–52px across templates, 900 on poster templates.

styles.name: translation
styles.usage: The Armenian translation (.am) and cover subtitle (.sub, 32px).

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Small uppercase field labels inside cards (.lbl), in --acc.

styles.name: handle
styles.usage: Footer handle, bottom-left of every slide.

styles.name: ui-label
styles.usage: Row labels (.row label), ui-muted, fixed 120px column.

styles.name: ui-hint
styles.usage: Helper text (.hint) and template tile labels (600).

styles.name: ui-code
styles.sample: It gets under my skin. | Աչքիս փուշն է։
styles.usage: The phrases textarea, one phrase per line.
